build_generator_resnet: build a GeneratorResNet model with a given input shape and number of residual blocks for CycleGAN image translation
build_discriminator: build a PatchGAN Discriminator model with a specified number of channels for CycleGAN adversarial training
build_residual_block: build a ResidualBlock with two convolution layers and instance normalization for use in the generator network
run_generator_forward: run a forward pass through the GeneratorResNet model to translate an input image to the target domain
run_discriminator_forward: run a forward pass through the Discriminator model to produce a real or fake prediction for an image
